g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: orange = parts added in that step; ghosted = parts still to come
H1 x8 M8 15 N·m; feet P1-462 M16
belt top z 905 ±2 both ends, level 1 / 1000 along and across; frames square to the spine (diagonals ±2)
H7 x4 M8 10 N·m (bushes: hand + 1/4 turn)
aperture bottom z 850 ±2; head-to-frame resistance on the +y lug > 1 MΩ (loop broken, T8)
H2 x16 M10 25 N·m (tail: snug only); H3 x2
pulley axes parallel 0.5 over 1,420 (T3); set screws in the bearings tight after alignment
H4 x8 M6 6 N·m (clips, outside the MFZ); H5 x20 nylon hand tight
bed top z 903 = pulley tops ±0.5 (straight edge); clearance to the aperture ≥ 10 all round
H12 x2 4 N·m + Loctite 243; H13 8 N·m (bush not crushed)
splice flat, no step > 0.2; belt tracks centred ±3 over 10 min at speed (take-up screws, T5)
gap S 76 / J 96.4 ±1, centred on y 0
H8 x6 M6 8 N·m; H9 clevis pins
retracted paddle face 8 outside the J guide line; extended: paddle passes the belt centre +40 (T10)
H10 x4 M6 4 N·m (PC box); H11 U-bolts 6 N·m
wiring per E01, < 0.1 Ω PE (T13); program P1-406-FW-01 loaded; head validated with the test pieces (T15-T18)
1. Set the end frames 101 (infeed) and 102 (outfeed) on their feet, 1,420 between the pulley centres; bolt the spine 103 to the leg braces; bolt the head stand 104 to the spine at x 0.
2. Lift the head P1-418 onto the stand: G10 pad and nylon shoulder bushes under the +y lug, plain on the -y lug. Centre the aperture on the belt line (y 0) and on the bed height.

3. Bolt the 4 UCFL204 flanges loose on the side-plate ears; slide the drive pulley 201 (keyed shaft to -y) into the outfeed pair and the tail pulley 202 into the infeed slots; fit the take-up screws 203.
4. Thread the two FRP rails 204 through the head aperture; clip them to the side plates with 205; lay the UHMW bed 206 on the rails and screw down with nylon screws (no metal in the MFZ).

5. Thread the open belt P1-419 through the aperture over the bed, round both pulleys and back under through the aperture; splice in place (finger splice, supplier or hot press). Fit the gearmotor P1-420 + torque arm 401.
6. Guide brackets 208 to the side plates in the S or J slot position; guide strips 207 on the brackets (infeed 280 pair, outfeed 70 pair). No guide inside the MFZ.

7. Pusher bracket 301 to the -y outfeed plate, actuator P1-421 + paddle 302; locked bin 303 hooked on the +y plate, lid and hasp; eye brackets 304 + B1 eye and reflector, B2 in the bin slot, B3 on the lid.
8. Controls box P1-459 on bracket 402 on the -y infeed leg; beacon pole 403 + stack light P1-461 on the +y infeed leg; cables W1, W5-W10 per E01, P-clipped on the legs, away from the head.
SETUP (1:8), FROM -Y: METAL-FREE ZONE, RAILS, REJECT

g.text: FRP RAILS + UHMW BED, NYLON SCREWS ONLY

svg.text: 1. Belt splice: cut square to length (3,035 + the maker's finger allowance) with the tail at mid take-up; finger-cut both ends, press at the maker's temperature, trim. No metal lacing or clips ever: they would trip the head.
2. Changeover shaker ↔ jar (about 2 min, belt stopped): move the 6 guide brackets 208 to the S or J slot ends (2 screws each). Nothing else changes; the head sees both (66 / 86.4 Ø).
3. Each pack: the operator sets it on the belt between the infeed guides, one at a time, ≥ 286 apart; the belt runs 16 m/min. Rejects stop the belt for ≈ 9 s; hold packs while amber/red.

4. Every 4 h, at start and after any stop > 30 min: pass the Fe, NFe and SS test pieces through the aperture centre on a pack, each must be rejected into the bin and confirmed by B2 (record in the CCP-1 log).

5. Cleaning: dry wipe; belt with food-safe detergent, no water jet on the head control or the box. Care: belt tracking weekly; bearings grease monthly (food grade H1); belt replace when cut or frayed.
HARDWARE AND TORQUES (all A2 stainless; full spec on 800)
